label: D2 after choosing a1 (mostly reaching S1), fading over the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and essentially only when this trial chose a1 (99.9% of mass; in_action==1); 90% of mass when the reached state is S1 (common a1). Not every a1 D2 step activates (precision 0.32 for phase==D2 & action==1, recall 0.99): rate falls steadily over the episode (13% of steps in trials 0-9, ~0 in trials 90-99), so restricting to ep_trial<50 gives dev F1 0.65. Magnitude is largest right after switching to a1 (stay==0: 15% of activations but 30% of mass, precision 0.76), e.g. the top windows are a1->S1 trials following unrewarded a2 runs; it is also higher when the model value is high. Does not fire on a2 trials, on D1 or GO. All variables are observed at D2.
